is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. arabiensis, An. coluzzii, and An. gambiae s.s.) in Dielmo, Senegal.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (kdr-west/1014F) and Vgsc L995S (kdr-east/1014S) in Table 1.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 provides genotype counts (LL, LF, LS, FS, FF, SS) and allele counts for An. arabiensis, An. coluzzii, and An. gambiae s.s.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from field breeding sites in Dielmo, Senegal, in September 2015.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting original field collection and laboratory analysis.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in Dielmo, Fatick region, Senegal.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted in September 2015.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new collection and analysis of mosquitoes from Dielmo in 2015.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including genotype counts and bioassay results, are provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study investigated insecticide resistance and kdr mutations in Anopheles gambiae s.l. in Dielmo, Senegal, following 10 years of universal LLIN coverage. CDC bottle bioassays and PCR genotyping were performed on field-collected mosquitoes. The study found resistance to DDT and suspected resistance to several pyrethroids, with both L1014F and L1014S mutations present in the population.
